rule: All local model weights, model runtimes with large model payloads, and large inference caches must default to drive D:. Do not install/store model payloads on C: unless the user explicitly overrides this rule.
preflight: Before downloading a local model, verify the destination resolves to D:.
If a runtime defaults to C:, reconfigure its model/cache directory before downloading weights.
Do not silently fall back to C: for large model files.
exception_policy: Only an explicit user instruction may override this D-drive default.
